subject: OrionSoft renewal: e-invoice / treasury onboarding + PO and net-term change
messages:
From: Laura Mendez <laura@orionsoft.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: OrionSoft AP <ap@orionsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal billing steps — PO attached, request for e-invoice onboarding

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to confirm the renewal and add the 200k token capacity uplift (Q4 quota). Finance asked that we: 

- Issue a formal PO for the renewal (attached as ORION-PO-7892.pdf)
- Move our billing to Net60 (previously Net30) for this committed contract
- Onboard to Redwood's e-invoice/treasury portal so invoices can be pulled automatically into our ERP
- Confirm the correct tax form to return — we attached our W-8BEN-E for a U.S. foreign entity.

Can you confirm the contact you want us to list on the PO (billing contact + email) and whether Redwood needs any additional vendor setup info? If possible we need the invoice routing and vendor ID so our AP team can schedule the payment window.

Attachments: ORION-PO-7892.pdf (application/pdf), Orion_W-8BEN-E.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Laura Mendez
Head of Finance, OrionSoft
laura@orionsoft.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Mendez <laura@orionsoft.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal billing steps — PO attached, request for e-invoice onboarding

Hi Laura — thanks for sending this over and for the PO. Attachment received and uploaded to our billing queue.

Plan:
1) Naomi (Account) will own the renewal acceptance and confirm the committed SKU and uplift.
2) Kimberly (Payments) will validate the PO, register OrionSoft in our vendor system, and raise a vendor ID for your AP team.
3) We can support Net60 on the renewed contract; I have routed for approval since it's outside standard Net30 for new renewals but within our escalation box for strategic accounts.
4) We will send an e-invoice portal invite (for your AP) and provide the vendor ID + invoice routing details once Kimberly confirms the vendor setup.

Naomi/Kim — can you confirm the expected timeline for vendor ID (EFT routing and portal invite) and if the W-8 is sufficient for our records, or whether we need additional evidence?

Laura — I will keep you posted but expect vendor ID and portal invite within 48 business hours if all docs are fine.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
